about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all six shots and recorded in README.md's capture block: window 1440x763 on the deployed build at ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.boot(); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30), then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot, vitals pinned at 100, the level's own hostiles cleared (never DEV.clear()), level banner taken down with banner('', 0). A frozen clock does not stop S.t, so these frames are reproducible by statistics and never by md5. **One term this plan did not record: the audio device.** A live boot advances the seeded stream through SND.init's noise buffer before the generator runs, so one seed deals one level per sample rate (#404, and the rule the tool prints as HW_WHY). These six captures read no SND.ac.sampleRate, so every row carries `sampleRate: null`, `check` prints each one as a device-scoped deal, and the binding below is per-machine: it says this frame is what ?dev=1&seed=60 dealt on the capture's audio device, not that every machine deals it. `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` gates the missing term. A capture that reads the rate turns its own row into a cross-machine binding with no change to the tool.

shots.note: Deal transcribed from README.md's capture block, which names all six shots as one route: the deployed page opened at ?dev=1&seed=60, build proved by eval-visible code markers, every deployed js blob md5-identical to the tree at ce9d39d. layout is that block's DEV.layoutSig() for the deal. Pose: one posed grunt 6 m out on the camera's own band (a posed body added with DEV.spawn, never DEV.clear, which would leave 0 LEFT on the HUD).

Same route as level0-spawn; see that row for where each field was recorded. Shot 8be1f96 is the one whose caption names black air above the four risers - the reason #333 reopened, and the reason this artifact exists.
Same route as level0-spawn. Feet on floor -1.00 in the pit, lamp at (20.5, 16.5) one cell over - a pose named in the caption, so the deal field is what makes it re-takeable rather than a description.
Same route as level0-spawn. The pit lip from 2.5 m out; the props the caption counts (9 lamps, 7 crates, 7 barrels) are this deal's, which is why seed and layout are gated and the counts are not.

The reference shot for the block: the route and every deal field in these six rows are transcribed from README.md's capture block (deployed build, ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.layoutSig 735688443, js blobs md5-identical to ce9d39d) rather than re-measured here. #335 measured this route: reloading the same URL read DEV.seed 60 and layout 735688443 on both loads, which is what makes origin+install=url-open a binding route.

Re-taken at cc10ef4 (#388, third frame for this issue) because main's third take of #375 - the far ceiling stops paying a tall ceiling's bounce light to rays that reach no ceiling - paints into this exact seat, and the deployed page began serving it while the previous capture of this row was in review. Route is the same instrument as the other five and is the URL itself: headless Chromium opened this row's url with a 1440x763 device-metrics override at scale 1, and the route ran from a script injected at document so it fires the moment js/90_dev.js installs DEV rather than one CDP round trip later: DEV.boot(); startLevel(3, true); banner('', 0); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; DEV.cam(1.5, 2.5, floorAt(1.5, 2.5), 0.60, 0); DEV.tick(1); the level's own 4 hostiles left standing. One step the earlier rows did not need: a page that never acquires a pointer lock pauses on the first blur, and the pause overlay dims everything beneath it, so the route ends with the game's own resume() and one more DEV.tick(1) when S.mode is not 'play'. Without that step the frame is a paused frame and reads 14.48 mean, which is how it was caught. The deployed index.html and all eleven js/ blobs were read over the wire at capture time and are md5-identical to this tree, whose js/ is main's at cc10ef4 - so the URL and the tree name one build, which is the claim the previous row could no longer make. layout 2307539281 is DEV.layoutSig() read back after that route and reproduced on six consecutive loads; it is NOT the 3233039185 the previous row carried. The difference is the MAP.cell half of the hash - pickWallTex panel choices (js/20_level.js) drawn from a different point in the seeded stream, now that #400's fixture placement also draws from it - not MAP.fz, which this level authors cell by cell. Geometry and tone reproduce; panel choice does not, and this row now says so with a measured number instead of an apology. SND.ac.sampleRate read 44100 at capture time, so this row is a cross-machine binding where the other five are device-scoped. Frame mean luma 50.44, thirds 41.8 / 58.6 / 50.9; against the bytes it replaces, 150,360 px moved by more than 2 luma and 124,799 of them are in the middle third, the far ceiling above the TECH wall, with the floor third moving 0.01.
